To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the turnover rate of ruminal ingesta was similar for all cows and across lactation periods and that there were small differences in the total retention times of liquid, grain or hay fractions across lactation periods.
the turnover rate of ruminal ingesta was 4% per hour, and the turnover rate of liquid was 8% per hour.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of stage of lactation on the retention time and turnover rate of liquid, hay and grain.
rumen turnover rate and retention of liquid, grain (maize) and hay fractions of ingesta in dairy cows at various stages of lactation.
the relationship of rumen turnover rates of liquid and solid ingesta with the stage of lactation and with dietary factors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
rumen turnover rates of liquid and solid fractions of ingesta are not significantly affected by stage of lactation or level of intake.
the turnover rate of ingesta in the rumen is relatively unaffected by level of intake or stage of lactation but does change with hay: grain ratio.
the turnover rates and total mean retention times of ingesta in the rumen are not influenced by stage of lactation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the turnover rate of ingesta was not affected by stage of lactation or level of intake.
ruminal turnover rates of ingesta were not affected by stage of lactation.
the retention time of liquid was not affected by stage of lactation or diet composition, but was affected by level of intake.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a great deal of variation in rumen turnover rates among animals and that this variation may be greater than that caused by changes in diet.
the rumen is a dynamic system that changes in response to changes in the ration.
the ruminal retention time of liquid and solid feedstuffs is not influenced by lactation number, stage of lacta tion, diet, or level of intake.
